maddeler.e:
أتمرمغ (form IIq)
# أَتَمَرْمَغُ (ʔatamarmaḡu) /ʔa.ta.mar.ma.ɣu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَرْمَغَ (tamarmaḡa)
# أَتَمَرْمَغَ (ʔatamarmaḡa) /ʔa.ta.mar.ma.ɣa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَرْمَغَ (tamarmaḡa)
# أَتَمَرْمَغْ (ʔatamarmaḡ) /ʔa.ta.mar.maɣ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَرْمَغَ (tamarmaḡa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
